name: Taste LGD #7
description:
Nine thousand taste buds send signals to the mind,
The mind interprets what our taste will find.
These signals they vary depending where on the tongue
Nine thousand taste buds when we are young
Explosion of flavor,
Explosion of youth!
How sweet life is,
When life is a sweet tooth.
